name: Pending Withdrawal Requests
query:
SELECT
  wr.name as "Request:Link/Withdrawal Request:150",
  w.party_type as "Party Type::150",
  w.party as "Party::180",
  wr.amount as "Amount:Currency:120",
  wr.method as "Method::120",
  wr.requested_on as "Requested On:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabWithdrawal Request` wr
JOIN `tabWallet` w ON w.name = wr.wallet
WHERE wr.status = 'Pending'
ORDER BY wr.requested_on ASC
